content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides a total of 9 vacancies distributed across five distinct posts within the Department of Physical Education and Sports.

rows.experience: Eight years teaching experience, out of which five years' experience in an institute/college/department of physical education.

rows.qualification: M.P.Ed. degree or its equivalent with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade, i.e., B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms.
rows.experience: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/Industry, excluding the period of Ph.D. research, with evidence of published work and a minimum of 5 publications as books and/or research/policy papers.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available in Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 temporary vacancies available across various teaching and training posts in the Department of Physical Education and Sports.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications for Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online walk-in interview will be conducted through Google Meet on 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) or its equivalent with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade (B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms).

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: Assistant Professors receive ₹1,000/- per day, subject to a maximum of ₹25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must submit their applications along with all relevant supporting documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Are these positions permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointments are purely temporary for a period of one (1) year and may be extended, subject to the University's requirements and approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q8. What email address should be used to submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates receive the interview meeting link?
faq.answer: The meeting link for the Google Meet online walk-in interview will be communicated to eligible candidates via their registered email addresses.
